prompt:
Use case: ads-marketing, compositing.
Create ONE revised 9:16 vertical Instagram story invitation, a carefully art-directed evolution of image 1. User likes image 1, but wants a little more story and photographs of their actual work.
INPUT ROLES:
Image 1 is the EDIT TARGET and style reference: preserve the warm ivory textured paper, real deep cobalt-blue felt-tip handwritten lettering, friendly personal note character, photographer's selfie, and simple blue drawn camera. Reflow the composition elegantly to fit the extra content; do not simply cram more text into existing spaces.
Image 2 is a supporting photographic INSERT: actual portfolio work, young man with brown leather-sleeved jacket in warm sunshine. Preserve this photograph faithfully, same face, eyes, expression, hair, jacket, background, light, grain and warm color. Do not generate a new portrait inspired by it.
Image 3 is a supporting photographic INSERT: actual portfolio work, brunette woman with pale blue eyes, black fur coat and hands holding lapels against a light textured wall. Preserve this photograph faithfully, same face, expression, eyes, hair, clothing, hands, background, light, crop character and color. Do not generate a new portrait inspired by it.
REQUESTED DESIGN:
A coherent personal note that introduces Aidan, explains the simple reason for this invitation, shows two convincing samples of his work, and invites a DM. Warm and understated with elegant breathing room. All copy in readable cobalt-blue handwriting, varying scale naturally. No typeset advertising font.
At the top a large flowing handwritten "Charlotte,".
Below, an introduction area: a modest rectangular photographer selfie extracted faithfully from image 1 at left (smaller than the portfolio photos); to its right the handwritten introduction "I’m Aidan. I make portraits." followed by the story "I want to meet new people here and make more photos like these." The story is smaller, but comfortably legible on a phone; break lines naturally. No invented relocation, credentials, background, guarantees or dates.
Middle: label "my work" in small casual blue handwriting, then the TWO large photographic inserts side by side as clean physical print rectangles with narrow ivory margins, near-upright with just a tiny natural difference of angle. Together these prints should take about 37% of the total canvas height and dominate the photographic content. Use attractive portrait crops that retain both faces clearly, show the man's jacket and the woman's fur-coat shoulders and lapels. No overlapping handwriting on faces. Portfolio prints visibly larger and more important than the selfie.
Below photos: friendly fairly large "You bring a face." then "I’ll bring the camera." A small simple blue camera doodle may sit alongside if room; remove it if it compromises spacing.
Bottom: large underlined "Free photo shoot." then confident very large "DM me." Clean comfortable margins and all elements inside the canvas.
Exact visible copy only:
"Charlotte,"
"I’m Aidan. I make portraits."
"I want to meet new people here and make more photos like these."
"my work"
"You bring a face."
"I’ll bring the camera."
"Free photo shoot."
"DM me."
No extra words, red ink, logos, watermarks, elaborate scrapbook embellishments, empty photo slots, generated replacement faces, or duplicated photographs. Preserve the low-key handwritten personality of image 1. The story and actual photographic work are the substantive additions.
